definitions.explanation: The first game or match of a sports season, tournament, or series.

examples.japanese: {開幕戦|かいまくせん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{勝|か}った→勝つ：01199_katsu⟧。
⟦プロ{野球|やきゅう}→プロ野球：08837_puroyakyuu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{開幕戦|かいまくせん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}→見る：00283_miru⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}った→行く：00119_iku⟧。
examples.english: I went to see the professional baseball season opener.

examples.japanese: ⟦{今年|ことし}→今年：00722_kotoshi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦サッカー→サッカー：04726_sakkaa⟧⟦リーグ→リーグ：11600_riigu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{開幕戦|かいまくせん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{三月|さんがつ}→三月：00665_sangatsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{予定|よてい}→予定：00824_yotei⟧⟦されている→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: This year's soccer league opening game is scheduled for March.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{開幕|かいまく}→開幕：08174_kaimaku⟧ (opening, raising the curtain) + ⟦{戦|せん}→〜戦：28346_sen⟧ (match, game, battle). Originally a theater term (⟦{開幕|かいまく}→開幕：08174_kaimaku⟧ = raising the curtain), now widely used in sports contexts. In Japan, the start of the professional baseball season (⟦{開幕|かいまく}→開幕：08174_kaimaku⟧) is a significant cultural event each spring.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {開幕戦|かいまくせん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{飾|かざ}る→飾る：01185_kazaru⟧: to grace the opening game (to win it memorably)
- {開幕戦|かいまくせん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{先発|せんぱつ}→先発：17735_senpatsu⟧: starting pitcher/player in the season opener
- {開幕戦|かいまくせん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦チケット→チケット：11014_chiketto⟧: tickets for the opening game

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {最終戦|さいしゅうせん}: final game — the last game of a season or tournament
- ⟦{開幕|かいまく}→開幕：08174_kaimaku⟧: opening (of a season/event) — the broader concept, not limited to a specific game
- ⟦{初戦|しょせん}→初戦：21654_shosen⟧: first match — used for tournament first rounds, while {開幕戦|かいまくせん} refers specifically to the season or series opener
